2. From each block's center, shoot a horizontal ray right to the grid edge (in the block's color).
3. Connect each block's lower-right corner to the next block's lower-right corner (going top-to-bottom), then the last to a virtual point just below the grid — drawing vertical connectors at the right column, colored by the upper block.

Let me submit candidate inputs to confirm.
